name: Skyrim Conky – Parchment Edition
author: bobbycomet
description: A parchment-styled Conky theme built to look like a page out of Skyrim's in-game journal. Tracks CPU, RAM, storage, and network use with bars that drain like in-game resources, alongside real-world weather, date, moon phases, and a Dragon Word display. Fully compatible with Conky Studio's Manager tab.
